column1: # THE LOBSTER HOSTILE-CORPUS RUN's CARRIED FINDINGS (make/lobster-hostile.mk;
# test/conformance/lobster/hostile). One name<TAB>finding per line: every line is a

# and on a line whose case has gone green, so the list cannot rot.

# tabletext Model.Read); its Lobster reader is schema-lobster-json-form, not on
# this base. message, message_novocab, announce*: the Lobster message form
# (schema-lobster-message-form) is not on this base. A card that lands deletes
# its lines here in the same change.
